name: Galle
coordsNote: Galle Fort. The nomad/surf scene is along the coast: Unawatuna (~6 km east), Ahangama and Weligama (~20–30 km east).

US.note: Free ETA (apply online before arrival): 30 days, double entry, free since 25 May 2026; extendable for a fee at the Department of Immigration (up to 270 days in total).

english.note: Good in town (expat hub — above national average)
english.rationale: Sri Lanka is in the moderate band on the EF EPI 2025 (score 486, rank 73), which maps to tier 1 in scripts/add_english.py. English is a widely used link language, and the Galle Fort–Unawatuna–Ahangama strip runs on foreign tourism and long-stay surfers/nomads, so +1 for the tourist/expat economy.

vibe: Walled Dutch-era fort town with surf beaches and a nomad strip nearby
narrative: A UNESCO-listed fort of ramparts, churches and colonial villas on a headland, with Unawatuna's bay a few kilometres east and the surf-and-café strip of Ahangama and Weligama 20–30 km along the coast. It is a Dec–Apr base: the May–Sep south-west monsoon and the Oct–Nov inter-monsoon rains bring rough seas, and coworking is café-scale rather than a deep hub.

season.rationale: Editorial estimate. Sri Lanka's leisure arrivals peak Dec–Mar and bottom out in May–Jun, when the south-west monsoon reaches the south and west coasts (SLTDA 2025). Jul–Aug arrivals recover but mostly head for the east coast, so Galle is only Shoulder then. Oct–Nov inter-monsoon rains keep the south coast quiet until December.

safety.propertyNote: Opportunistic theft, motorbike bag-snatching, card fraud, tuk-tuk overcharging
safety.womensSafetyNote: Sexual harassment of women travellers reported; caution on buses and in crowds
safety.touristRationale: Visitor risks are petty theft, card fraud and overcharging, already in the property score; no evidence of a visitor-targeted violent risk.

rationale.property: FCDO reports a rise in low-level opportunistic crime, motorbike bag-snatching and common card fraud; the south coast adds tuk-tuk overcharging. A small fort town and beach villages sit around Bali (64) and Dumaguete (64), below Hoi An (72).
rationale.tourist: Crime against visitors is opportunistic rather than targeted; 1.0, like comparable beach towns.
rationale.womens: FCDO specifically warns of sexual harassment of women (most reports in crowded places like markets and bus stations) and suggests personal alarms for solo travellers. -5 on the country Gallup baseline, as for Bali's party-scene adjustment.

selection: South-coast base and the catalog's first South Asian city; the Dec–Apr dry season on the south-west coast fills the winter window. Comparables: Hoi An, Bali (Canggu/Ubud), Dumaguete.
researchNotes: Visa: Sri Lanka's free-ETA scheme (from 25 May 2026) covers the US, UK, AU and only 12 EU states; no end date is published, so re-check before shipping updates. visaFree=false because an ETA (pre-arrival authorisation) is still required, as with Vietnam's e-Visa in the catalog. US advisory is country-wide Level 2 with no higher regional level for the south; the advisory text came from cadataapi.state.gov because travel.state.gov served a bot check. The Dept of Meteorology site gave no usable climate text, so the hazard source is the official Statistical Abstract climate chapter. New region 'S Asia'.
